title: 27B arm bench + KLD + upgrade validation (radiance 1.11.0/1.17.0, sly 1.11.0)
notes: Arm D (the emitted vllm block) = RedHat-MXFP4 @ sly 1.11.0-rocm10.1, starter-exact env (WATCHDOG_MIB 32,
GPU_UTIL 0.93, CACTUS_DELTA 0, dp-sharp chat template) — the sly 1.11.0 validation arm (vs the 1.9.1 row).
Arms A/B/C are the NATIVE radiance runtime — not vllm-expressible in this spec (RULE-6 GAP: recommend
gen_campaign learn server: radiance | vllm engine kinds). Hand-added server blocks below the D block:
A = Quark-MXFP4 .rad @ stilldeadcode/radiance:1.11.0 (baseline), B = same .rad @ 1.17.0,
C = IQ4R-L-V4 .rad @ 1.17.0 — all 260000 ctx / 2 seqs / fp8 KV / --gpu-headroom-mib 596 /
--num-speculative-tokens 7 (27b.conf), slugs a-*/b-*/c-* (same 8 cells each).
Round 1 = 8 cells/arm: depths 10k/100k x tg 512/1024 x n 1/2, reps 1. Round 2 (--round 2, hand-added,
ROUND-guarded) = 50k x tg{512,1024,4096} x n{1,2} + tg4096 x 10k/100k x n{1,2} (10 cells/arm).
KLD (WS3, bench/perf/kld_probe.py; method locked in research/ws3-kld-r2.md): paired greedy continuation
(temp 0, logprobs 20, shared-prefix pairing, first-divergent position included; radiance never returns
prompt logprobs so prompt-scoring cannot be the uniform mode — optional labeled bonus pass on sly pairs),
KL(ref||arm) per sly kv4/kl_compare.py (floor for missing tokens => lower bound), cluster bootstrap
CI (block = prompt) + pooled cross-check, 5-point live selftest per engine family (first radiance boot
= arm A, first sly boot = arm D) that aborts the KLD pass only. Reference = Qwen__Qwen3.8-27B-FP8@
017b9c7a on one dedicated boot (sly-radiance/qwen38-fp8, IMAGE pinned 1.11.0), its fetch cached in
tmp/ (resumable). Calibration set: inputs/calibration-prompts.jsonl (file-head prompts, code-dominated
mix from bench/workloads/corpus/, ~96-160 prompts x 200-2000-token heads, raw text no chat template),
hash-pinned via inputs/calibration-manifest.jsonl + inputs/calibration.sha256. Noise floors: A-vs-B
pair = engine-version floor; reference self-run = boot noise.
WS7 prologue (hand-added, before arm D): sly 1.11.0 first-boot phase breakdown (this boot = arm D's cold
boot) -> stop -> warm reboot -> seconds; cache pre-check label from the session-1 CPU check.
Every probe run is wrapped by a Memory-Fault watcher on the serve log (iron rule 15); radiance residency
(amd-smi process) recorded per boot (rule 15b).
This run.sh must be launched from a plain terminal with NO local-model Claude session running (it calls
gpu_exclusive.sh per arm — that kills any session server, plan hard constraint).
